topic: Higher-value Memories and slower post-onboarding unlock cadence
currentUserGoal: Make second-tier Memories cost enough to require choices while making every purchase feel substantially more powerful in the active field.
workCompleted: Kept the mandatory Tiny Sprinkler Memory at 5 Grass Touches and the first field-growth threshold at 2 so onboarding still works.
Raised helper unlock costs progressively from Field Mouse through Meadow Rabbit, with later helpers now representing major progression goals.
Raised ranked Memory costs and their growth curves so a typical early reward cannot buy most of a tier at once.
Doubled the manual-touch benefit of every Memory purchase from 1.5% to 3%.
Strengthened helper throughput, storage, efficiency, and starting-stock ranks.
Strengthened Fast Touch, Broad Palm, Many Hands, Ancient Heartwood, Green Afterglow, and Verdant Aegis.
Made Memory Grove descriptions derive their effect numbers from shared gameplay constants.
Added progression-budget coverage proving that 50 Grass Touches can buy the three cheapest available post-onboarding choices, but not four.
Reduced phone Memory Web clutter by showing rank, pips, and price details only for the focused node while keeping node names visible.
verificationRun: npm run check passed: ESLint, 205 Vitest tests across 24 files, strict TypeScript, and the Vite production build.
Desktop Memory Grove verification confirmed the stronger Clockwork Nozzle effect, +3% manual-touch contribution, and higher next-rank cost.
Phone verification at 390x844 confirmed readable node names, focused-node details, and no all-node cost-label crowding.
The local ecosystem playtest remains available at http://127.0.0.1:5173/?redesign&ecosystemPrototype&playtest&debugPanel.
git diff --check passed apart from normal Windows LF-to-CRLF notices.
knownIssues: The new economy is protected by deterministic budget tests but still needs a clean hands-on three-to-five-run balance pass.
Existing saves keep their purchased ranks and immediately receive the stronger effects.
The unrelated docs/CODEX_GITHUB_SETUP_GUIDE.md remains untracked and is not part of this slice.
nextRecommendedSteps: Play three clean runs and record how many Grass Touches remain after each purchase decision.
Judge whether the stronger Memories are immediately perceptible in touch cadence, helper output, survivability, and automation.
Adjust individual outlier Memories instead of flattening the whole cost curve if one branch still feels weak.
doNotRevert: Do not raise the mandatory Tiny Sprinkler unlock above 5 Grass Touches without changing the guaranteed first-collapse reward.
Do not raise the first field-growth threshold above 2; the user explicitly wanted field expansion to arrive sooner.
Do not reduce Memory value by changing UI copy only; shared constants now drive both gameplay and descriptions.
Do not include docs/CODEX_GITHUB_SETUP_GUIDE.md without explicit user direction.
